title: Geospatial AI
text: Deep-learning models that find and count objects in drone, aerial and satellite imagery.

title: Drone mapping and analysis
text: I plan and fly the survey, then turn the imagery into orthomosaics, surface and terrain models, and counts.

title: Remote sensing and satellite analysis
text: Land cover, vegetation, water and change over time, read from optical and radar satellite imagery.

title: Spatial machine learning
text: Predictive models that explain their answers and are tested on areas they have not seen.

title: Flood and climate risk mapping
text: Where flooding is more likely, and which people, roads and facilities sit in the way.

title: GIS and spatial databases
text: Clean, queryable spatial data in PostGIS that your team and tools can use.

title: Web GIS development
text: Interactive web maps and spatial web apps, built with Leaflet and Streamlit, that work on any device.

title: Dashboards
text: Streamlit and Power BI dashboards that put results in front of the people deciding.
